title: Morning Brief — Friday, 18 September 2026
description: Today: Australia and New Zealand are floated as potential EU associate members as population growth hits 1.4%; a Queensland driving crackdown nets 81 charges and Far North Queensland beekeepers lose hives worth $20,000; and the Gold Coast unveils a 20-year vision for 185,000 new homes ahead of a Pink Ribbon Raceday. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
